questions.question: How many open care gaps does Practice 12 have, 2026-07 to 2026-09?
questions.independent_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT action_id) FROM actions WHERE status='open' AND practice_id=12 AND action_date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND action_date<DATE '2026-09-01'+INTERVAL 1 MONTH
questions.note: dedup on action_id: the 60 duplicated rows must not count twice

questions.question: Gap closure rate for Practice 12, 2026-07 to 2026-09

questions.question: How much was Practice 03 paid in 2026-04?
questions.independent_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(sum(amount),0),2) FROM payments WHERE practice_id=3 AND paid_month=DATE '2026-04-01'
questions.note: paid_month, not action month: April is low and May is high because half of April's run landed in May

questions.question: Gap closure rate, Practice 12, Q3, asked a second way (same expected value as q06)

questions.question: How many visits did Practice 12 have, Q3 2026?
questions.independent_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM visits WHERE practice_id=12 AND visit_date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND visit_date<DATE '2026-10-01'
questions.note: counted where the visit happened; walk-ins count at the practice visited

questions.question: Share of Practice 12's Q3 visits where the member had a completed action there that month
questions.independent_sql: SELECT ROUND(sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actions a WHERE a.status='completed' AND a.member_id=v.member_id AND a.practice_id=v.practice_id AND date_trunc('month', a.action_date)=date_trunc('month', v.visit_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/count(*),4) FROM visits v WHERE v.practice_id=12 AND v.visit_date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND v.visit_date<DATE '2026-10-01'
questions.note: join key is member + practice + month; a join on member alone would let a walk-in borrow another practice's completed actions

questions.question: Practice 12 scorecard, as of 2026-09: the quarter-to-date gap closure rate must be the Q3 rate
questions.independent_sql: same as q06; the eval pins the default window, not the metric
questions.note: the scorecard's defaults are a contract: quarter to date from the as-of month
